item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.27)] Micron Trades at 6 Times Next Year's Earnings. The $38 Billion of Capacity That Ends This Cycle Doesn't Open Until 2028.
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.27)
Micron Technology is trading at approximately 6 times next year's earnings, a valuation that the article suggests is low given the company's strong performance and the delayed impact of new market supply. While memory cycles historically end with new supply, major capacity additions by SK Hynix, totaling $38 billion, are not expected to become operational until 2028 and 2029. Micron has also secured long-term, take-or-pay customer contracts running through 2030, further enhancing financial predictability and suggesting the current boom may last longer than the market anticipates.
